create_submission_file: create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file from prediction results using the CLI
run_is2re_relaxations: run the script with --is2re-relaxations to write IS2RE results from trajectory files in a directory
run_hybrid_predictions: run the script with --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid to write IS2RE results from S2EF NPZ prediction files
write_predictions_function: write predictions from an NPZ results file to a challenge submission file with challenge_ prefixed keys
write_is2re_relaxations_function: write IS2RE relaxation energies from .traj files or hybrid S2EF predictions to a compressed NPZ submission file
